_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Exa's public surface is three sites: the exa.ai marketing pages (light only, a --brand-*/--gray-*/--secondary-*/--cream token layer), the auth.exa.ai sign-in card dashboard.exa.ai redirects to (light only, its own --text-light-*/--secondary-* values) and the exa.ai/docs Mintlify docs (a real light/dark pair: --primary/--gray-* triplets, --default-border-color flips, the Mintlify --color-* layer and --docs-*/--twoslash-* component vars). Declared scales under core.*; the marketing and sign-in roles under light.*; the docs roles under light.* and dark.*. Measured roles alias the declared values they match.
